envelope.description: Let the turn lifecycle say whether a turn is in progress, and report a failed follow

body.title: Let the turn lifecycle say whether a turn is in progress, and report a failed follow
body.summary: Add busy() to the lifecycle. Make a follow call its sink's end callback when the resume fails as well as when it ends normally.
acceptanceChecks: busy is true and false at the moments the design lists, and a superseding turn keeps it true
A follow whose resume fails calls its end callback once and busy is false then

tests.name: turn lifecycle: busy is true while a started turn waits, sets up or is read and while a follow is read; false after the terminal event is handed over, after a follow ends, after stop and detach, and when follow returns without following; a superseding turn keeps it true
turn lifecycle: a follow whose resume fails calls its end callback exactly once, and busy is false when it is called
